integrity: All-order argument uses an exact finite-state recurrence and a complete twenty-state four-step arithmetic certificate. The accompanying standalone program enumerates 58,624 marked test families directly on seven small spiders and checks the recurrence. Computational tests do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem is for proper three-colourings of three-arm spiders under one-hot vertex-colour Boolean tests. The asymmetric formula is a twenty-state max-plus recurrence; a simple closed formula is asserted only for equal arm lengths. Absolute historical priority and independent mathematical validation are not established.
title: A four-step shattering law for ternary-coloured spider trees
